description: On startup, re-ignites agent runs that were interrupted by the last restart so work resumes automatically. Turn off to let interrupted runs stay stopped. Applies after a restart.
_note: Wired-in core one-shot (app/agent/runner.resume_orphans_at_boot). main.py gates the leader 'boot-orphan-resume' registration on ability_app_enabled('boot_orphan_resume'). Descriptor-only by design.
